camera_duration_s.source: ASSUMED project protocol: docs/D435I_CALIBRATION_PLAN.md sections 4 and 7; calibration/lab/README.md. Kalibr camera-imu-calibration wiki motivates short all-axis takes; this interval is project policy, not a quoted wiki limit.

allan_duration_hours.source: ASSUMED provisional project minimum: docs/D435I_CALIBRATION_PLAN.md section 5. Kalibr IMU-Noise-Model wiki recommends approximately 15–24 hours.

rates_hz.source: SOURCE-SUPPORTED calibration/lab/pi/record_calib_take.sh and calibration/allan/d435i_imu_record.cpp requested/resolved profiles.

gap_periods.source: ASSUMED existing take_diagnostics.py and tools/take_tools gap policy.

allowed_discontinuities.source: PROPOSED qualification policy: no missing frame numbers, duplicates, reversals, gaps, or domain changes.

min_samples.source: CALCULATED minimum to measure a time interval; not a sufficient take duration.

allowed_sdk_domains.source: SOURCE-SUPPORTED project calibration plan domain whitelist; single D435i device, no clock mapping.

stereo_skew_ns.source: ASSUMED existing tools/take_tools stereo pairing policy (unique frame numbers, same SDK clock).

audit_stamp_tolerance_ns.source: ASSUMED docs/D435I_CALIBRATION_PLAN.md conversion audit tolerance of 1 microsecond; callback versus bag SDK stamp comparison only.

gyro_rms_rad_s.source: PROPOSED per-axis raw gyro RMS minimum. Kalibr camera-imu-calibration wiki requires all rotational/translational axes excited; these numerical limits are not from Kalibr.

accel_std_m_s2.source: PROPOSED per-axis population standard deviation minimum. Gravity projected during rotations contributes; this does not prove independent translational observability.

motion_gyro_norm_rad_s.source: PROPOSED nearest gyro sample norm defining motion for the blur proxy.

motion_match_max_ns.source: PROPOSED same-domain image-to-gyro nearest-sample limit; no interpolation or clock mapping.

sharpness_min.source: PROPOSED variance of four-neighbor Laplacian on original Y8 pixels, in squared gray levels. Exposure, texture and target scale confound blur.

low_sharpness_fraction_max.source: PROPOSED at most 10% low-sharpness frames during motion in each IR view.

sharpness_grid_stride.source: PROPOSED odd sampling stride on full-resolution Laplacian centers to bound stdlib CPU cost and avoid even-grid checkerboard aliasing; neighbors remain adjacent original pixels.

sdk_serial.source: MEASURED current unit in docs/PROJECT_STATE.md; do not substitute ASIC/USB/firmware-update identifiers.

firmware.source: MEASURED current unit in docs/PROJECT_STATE.md. Different firmware needs reviewed config and new evidence.

emitter_enabled_readback.source: SOURCE-SUPPORTED calibration/lab/pi/record_calib_take.sh emitter OFF contract; IMU-only profile alone is not a physical readback.

ir_dimensions.source: SOURCE-SUPPORTED existing fixed calibration recorder profile, Y8.

card_limit_bytes_s.source: MEASURED historical microSD sustained write limit, experiments/2026-10-14-SESSION_FACTS_ADDENDUM.md section 3; not qualification of a replacement card.

write_headroom_fraction.source: PROPOSED reserve 20% of historical sustained card bandwidth; average payload rate cannot prove peak or fsync throughput.

free_reserve_bytes.source: ASSUMED existing calibration/lab recording wrapper 2 GiB OS reserve.

free_take_copies.source: PROPOSED remaining free space for two additional copies of the recorded payload plus OS reserve.
